intake.requirement: Original commit/tree fetched directly from riperiperi/FreeSO and every original blob compared. All 5,465 source/asset blobs match; only declared .gitignore metadata differs. Two pinned gitlinks remain part of unresolved registration/submodule closure, not gameplay qualification.

Expand active screens, primitives, network commands, packet maps, handlers, data providers, database/tasks, creator editors, SDK-default compilation, non-solution projects and submodule dispositions. The 71 seeded capability rows are not the entire game census.

capabilities.product_behavior: Sprite/depth reconstruction, embedded FSOM, replacement meshes/textures, cache precedence and invalidation
capabilities.journey: Load an original object family in 3D, verify replacement precedence and reconstructed fallback, rotate and pick it after cache reload.

capabilities.product_behavior: Full2D, Hybrid2D, Full3D and perspective/first-person camera transitions
capabilities.journey: Switch supported modes while interacting, preserving camera/picks and actual world state.

capabilities.product_behavior: Neighboring subworlds/facades, city roads/foliage, neighborhood geometry and thumbnails
capabilities.journey: Discover, inspect and enter a property with correct facade/thumbnail/neighbors; edit and reverify its representation.

capabilities.product_behavior: Room lighting/shadows, sky, particles and source-driven weather
capabilities.journey: Change room structure and time/weather inputs; inspect lighting, particles, visibility and context recovery.

capabilities.product_behavior: Instanced career/grade/role-matched robot-factory, restaurant and nightclub shifts
capabilities.journey: Match eligible players, respect ignore lists/roles, complete rounds, persist progression and return after disconnect.

capabilities.product_behavior: Single-object earning cohorts, economic history and dynamic payout tuning

capabilities.product_behavior: Durable visits, Top 100 and category-scaled visitor/property bonuses

capabilities.product_behavior: Size/floor upgrades, roommate costs, object capacity/disable rules and discounts

capabilities.product_behavior: Distinct community donations/build rights/sale rules and mayor property actions
capabilities.journey: Operate a community lot with builder/donor/visitor roles; verify donation value/wear treatment and denied private-sale paths.

capabilities.product_behavior: Six skills/locks, lot skill modes, welcome boosts and directional relationships

capabilities.product_behavior: Multi-actor acceptance/timeouts, held/contained objects, slots/reach, suits/accessories, headlines and pet rigs

capabilities.product_behavior: Timed tuning/events, participation dedup, configured age gifts, game token attributes and global cooldowns
